R362.note: Removing the incidental shell is the right fix, but the raw URL-decoded header is now written unencoded into a text/html response (XSS-shaped, not clearly cross-site exploitable) and the Utils.printOSCommandResults HTML wrapper is dropped while the write-up claims the output shape is unchanged.

R363.note: html/template with a package-level parsed template escapes both query values in body-text context; markup and Content-Type are otherwise identical and the ticketID change is stated.

R364.note: Bounds dataLen against payload.size() before the copy and rejects with std::length_error, which the stated contract permits; in-range calls copy all bytes and set length identically.

R365.note: NULL check on getenv returns 0 for an unset variable; strict/other set values behave exactly as before.

R366.note: Binds each algorithm to its own key with a single-element allowed list so the public-key-as-HMAC forgery fails; accepting HS256 against the declared hmacSecret is a stated change consistent with the class's design and all failure paths still return null.

R367.note: basename plus realpath prefix containment confines the sink to the reports directory; the Content-Disposition now using the sanitized name and the 400 for empty/./.. are stated and block no legitimate filename.

R368.note: Keeps the wire format and disables object construction with allowed_classes=false, dispatching JSON rows by leading {/[; legacy array carts and JSON carts both return their contents per the contract (nested objects, if any existed, would become incomplete classes - unknowable from the case).

R369.note: Uses the parameterized search(String, String, Object[], SearchControls) overload so JNDI escapes the value per RFC 2254; new SearchControls() is documented as equivalent to the original null.

R370.note: OWASP Java HTML Sanitizer allowlist applied before the model, th:utext kept for the sanitized rich text, title untouched; the allowlist policy and new dependency are stated and match the contract's sanitize-then-render requirement.

R371.note: Loops ReadAsync until the 8-byte header is full or EOF and gates each signature compare on totalRead, so the type decision uses only bytes actually read; storage behaviour and response shape are preserved.

R372.note: Swapping new Function for expr-eval-fork's AST evaluator closes the vector, but the fix exposes only top-level total/tax variables so the contract's own legitimate expression order.total + order.tax now throws 'undefined variable: order' - legitimate previews silently break and the write-up does not say so (the 200-char cap is a further stated restriction).

R373.note: Fixed allowlist maps the four macro tokens to literal method names so the tainted string never reaches dispatch; the change from fatal Error to silent return for unknown tokens is stated and blocks no legitimate macro.
